app.name: Spotify
app.description: A digital music, podcast, and video streaming service that provides access to millions of songs and other content from creators worldwide.

notes: Composio does not provide a default shared OAuth app for Spotify, requiring developers to configure their own developer application.
The mandatory redirect URI `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` must be correctly configured in the Spotify dashboard to avoid redirect mismatch errors.

Default scopes like user-read-private, user-read-email, app-remote-control, streaming, user-modify-playback-state, user-read-playback-state, and user-read-currently-playing are pre-configured in the toolkit.

assumption: An AI agent that manages playlists, controls playback, and reads profile data on behalf of Spotify users.

verdict.headline: Spotify requires an established business entity with 250k+ MAUs for production access, leaving public integrations gated behind stringent review criteria.
verdict.summary: You can immediately register an app in Development Mode to test with up to 5 allowlisted users who have Spotify Premium accounts. However, moving beyond development requires meeting strict criteria including an active service with 250,000 monthly active users and a formal partner application form. Review times officially reach up to 6 weeks, though community reports indicate extended waits during peak periods.

handsOnEffort.label: 2–4 hours
handsOnEffort.basis: Registering the app and configuring OAuth credentials in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.

timeToFirstConnection.label: Instant
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Development mode allows immediate testing with your own allowlisted premium account.

timeToProduction.label: 6–12 weeks
timeToProduction.basis: Official review SLA is up to 6 weeks, and criteria require an established business with 250k+ MAUs.

verdict.longestPole: Meeting strict business and MAU prerequisites alongside formal application review windows.
verdict.costDetail: Developer account and API usage are free, but app owner and test accounts require an active Spotify Premium subscription.

easierPaths.effect: Skip formal review entirely if your agent only serves up to 5 allowlisted test users.

factors.detail: Anyone can sign up at the Spotify Developer Dashboard and register a new app instantly.
Production access and extended quota modes require submitting a partner application form subject to review.
Extended Quota Mode requires an established business entity.
No explicit third-party technical security audit is documented as a prerequisite, though terms must be obeyed.
Spotify does not charge a fee for API access.
Production extended access requires applying via a partner application form with a company email.
Development mode apps are capped at 5 allowlisted test users.
End-users authenticate via standard OAuth 2.0 without requiring manual developer intervention per user beyond app allowlisting in dev mode.

phases.title: Register App
phases.outcome: A registered Spotify Developer app with a Client ID and Client Secret in Development Mode.

steps.title: Create a Spotify Developer Account
steps.details: Navigate to the **Spotify Developer Dashboard** and sign in using your regular Spotify account. Accept the Developer Terms of Service when prompted.

steps.title: Register a New App
steps.details: In the **Spotify Developer Dashboard**, click **Create app**. Provide an **App name** and **App description**. Enter the required Composio callback URI: `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` under **Redirect URIs**, select the appropriate API/SDK integrations, and save.
steps.agentAssist: Draft app name, description, and configure redirect URIs programmatically or provide them as copy-paste strings.

phases.title: Configure OAuth & Scopes
phases.outcome: OAuth credentials configured with the correct redirect URI and required permissions.

steps.title: Retrieve Client Credentials
steps.details: In your app dashboard settings, locate your **Client ID** and reveal your **Client Secret**. Copy both securely for your Composio configuration.

steps.title: Review Required Scopes
steps.details: Ensure your integration requests the necessary default scopes for the Spotify toolkit: `user-read-private`, `user-read-email`, `app-remote-control`, `streaming`, `user-modify-playback-state`, `user-read-playback-state`, and `user-read-currently-playing`.
steps.agentAssist: Map out scope requirements and draft the exact scope string list for Composio configuration.

phases.title: Test in Development Mode
phases.outcome: Successful local OAuth flow execution using allowlisted test accounts.

steps.title: Allowlist Test Users
steps.details: In the **Spotify Developer Dashboard** under your app settings, add up to 5 user accounts to your allowlist. Note that development mode requires the app owner and test users to have active **Spotify Premium** subscriptions.

steps.title: Verify OAuth Flow
steps.details: Trigger a test connection through Composio using your allowlisted account to ensure the authorization code exchange and token refresh work seamlessly.
steps.agentAssist: Run automated health checks on the Composio authentication endpoint.

phases.title: Prepare for Production Access
phases.outcome: Prerequisites gathered and partner application prepared for production quota extension.

steps.title: Verify Business and MAU Requirements
steps.details: Confirm your organization is an established business entity operating an active launched service with at least 250,000 Monthly Active Users (MAUs) as required for Extended Quota Mode.
steps.agentAssist: Draft internal documentation verifying current user metrics against Spotify thresholds.

steps.title: Submit Partner Application Form
steps.details: Fill out the Spotify partner application form using a company email address to request production quota extension and remove the 5-user allowlist limit.
steps.agentAssist: Draft text responses for app use-cases, architecture outlines, and compliance declarations.

phases.title: Go live in Composio
phases.outcome: Custom Spotify OAuth app fully integrated and functional inside Composio.

steps.title: Configure Custom App in Composio
steps.details: Navigate to the **Composio Dashboard**, select the **Spotify toolkit**, choose custom authentication, and paste your **Client ID** and **Client Secret**.
steps.agentAssist: Prepare the API payload parameters required to set up custom OAuth credentials via the Composio API.

steps.title: Initiate Live User Connection
steps.details: Execute a connection session via Composio to authenticate end users with the custom Spotify app credentials.
steps.agentAssist: Trigger test auth session initialization and handle callback verification.

requirements.detail: Required to log into the Spotify Developer Dashboard and create an app.
App owners and test users in Development Mode must have an active Spotify Premium account.
Required for Extended Quota Mode applications as of May 15, 2025.

scopes.purpose: Read access to user's subscription details and profile data.
Read access to user's email address.
Control playback on user's Spotify device.
Read access to user's current playback state.
Read access to what content is currently playing.

blockers.title: Development Mode User Cap Hit
blockers.symptom: Non-allowlisted users encounter an invalid client or access forbidden error during login.
blockers.howToProceed: Add the user's Spotify account email to the allowlist in the Spotify Developer Dashboard, ensuring they have an active Spotify Premium subscription.

blockers.title: Rate Limit Exceeded (HTTP 429)
blockers.symptom: API requests return status 429 and fail intermittently.
blockers.howToProceed: Implement exponential backoff handling using the `Retry-After` header returned in the API response.

blockers.title: Extended Quota Rejection
blockers.symptom: Partner application denied or ignored due to failing the 250k MAU threshold.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure the application meets all business entity and MAU criteria before submitting, or continue operating under Development Mode if serving internal tools.

nuances.title: Token Lifetimes and Refresh
nuances.detail: Spotify access tokens expire in 3600 seconds (1 hour). Requests return a refresh token alongside the access token to maintain persistent access without re-prompting user login.

nuances.title: PKCE and Flow Support
nuances.detail: Spotify supports standard OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow, Client Credentials, Device Code, and Authorization Code with PKCE (S256).

nuances.title: AI/LLM Training Prohibition
nuances.detail: Developer terms strictly prohibit using Spotify data for training AI or Large Language Models.

nuances.title: Rate Limiting Architecture
nuances.detail: Spotify enforces rate limits based on requests per second per app/user, responding with HTTP 429 and a `Retry-After` header when limits are crossed.

steps: Navigate to the Composio Dashboard and open the Spotify toolkit integration settings.
Select the option to use custom OAuth credentials rather than default app sharing.
Paste your Spotify Client ID and Client Secret into the respective configuration fields.
Ensure the redirect URI matches exactly: `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback`.
Save the custom auth configuration and initiate an authenticated user session.

openQuestions.question: What are the exact criteria for apps that fall between simple internal tools and the 250k MAU threshold?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Many growing startups or specialized B2B tools cannot meet 250k MAUs but need more than 5 test users.
openQuestions.howToResolve: Review Spotify's updated developer blog posts or contact Spotify developer support for clarification.
